pages.text: Hold wool and right-click the $(item)Spinning Wheel$(). It slows by itself: tap to keep its speed in the green until the yarn is spun. Wool makes three $(item)Yarn$() (up to ★3); dungeon spider silk makes $(item)Silk Thread$() (★5).
pages.title: Spinning

pages.text: Hold three thread (string, yarn or silk) and right-click a loom. Click when the thread lines up with the needle's eye. The $(item)Woven Cloth$() is no better than its thread.
pages.title: Weaving
